what: Read events from a BORIS export — read_boris
title: Read events from a BORIS export — read_boris
text: Read behavioural events BORIS export aniframe::anievent(). Two flat-text BORIS exports supported: aggregated events (one row per bout, default export shape) tabular events (one row per START / STOP / POINT transition; paired bouts reader). Time units come columns BORIS provides. default unit_time = "s" uses Start (s) / Stop (s) works BORIS export. unit_time = "frame" reader uses Image index start / Image index stop columns instead; frames stay aligned rows host aniframe::aniframe(), keeps event timing robust effective-FPS drift export paired movement data. "frame" requested export carries image-index columns, reader falls back "s" informational message. FPS recorded sampling_rate metadata without rescaling timestamps; call aniframe::set_sampling_rate() later need convert frames seconds. Channels: row's channel value BORIS's Behavioral category column populated, falling back literal "behavior" otherwise; label behaviour name, type "state" "point" mapped BORIS's Behavior type column. Overlap bouts channel permitted anievent side; aniframe::validate_anievent() flags overlapping state bouts warning rather rejecting . Modifiers travel via optional modifiers list-column; multi-column (Modifier #1, Modifier #2, ...) layout, legacy pipe-separated single-column (|b|None) layout, comma-separated values within single slot accepted.

title: Read Octron Segmentation Data — read_octron
text: path Path Octron CSV file. keep_bbox Keep bounding box coordinates? Default FALSE. video_height Optional numeric height source video frame pixels. Overrides value parsed CSV header available. method Strategy resolving frames Octron emitted multiple mask segments per track. One : "weighted" (default): area-weighted mean across segments per row. area becomes sum segment areas; orientation falls back "largest" (circular quantity, weighted mean undefined). "largest": take values single largest segment per row. "segments": expand multi-segment row one row per segment, adding segment identity variable. Segments matched across frames, filtering segment generally meaningful. source CSV contains tuple-valued rows, three methods produce identical numeric output. properties scikit-image / Octron region-property columns read. Newer Octron exports include dozens per-segment shape, intensity moment descriptors can dominate read time tuple-heavy files. One : "" (default): read every property column found file. Backwards-compatible prior read_octron() behaviour. character vector column names, e.g. c("area", "orientation"): read listed properties. Unknown names warned ignored. NULL character(0): skip property columns; result contains id columns centroid (bbox keep_bbox = TRUE). method = "weighted" area exists file absent argument, added automatically (area-weighted mean meaning otherwise) info message emitted.

title: aniread 0.5.1
text: get_supported_sources() returns source software aniread can read tibble source / reader / suffix, downstream packages can discover supported formats programmatically instead hard-coding . Closes #74.

title: aniread 0.5.1
text: read_octron() longer drops frames nothing detected. Octron omits frames entirely; reader now reinstates -NA rows across full track × frame grid (using analysed-frame count CSV header) time axis gap-free. Closes #80. read_boris(unit_time = "frame") longer fails exports inconsistent image index (e.g. STOP last video frame recorded frame 1, giving stop < start). FPS known, offending frame interval recovered round(time_s * fps). Closes #81.

title: aniread 0.5.0
text: read_boris() imports behavioural events BORIS export aniframe::anievent(). Supports two flat-text BORIS exports — aggregated events (one row per bout) tabular events (one row per START / STOP / POINT transition; paired bouts reader) — auto-detects format file’s first row. Channels taken BORIS’s Behavioral category populated, falling back literal "behavior"; modifiers travel via modifiers list-column newer multi-column (Modifier #1, Modifier #2, …) legacy single-column pipe-separated layouts. State-vs-point classification recorded metadata$variables_event. unit_time = "s" (default) reads Start (s) / Stop (s); pass unit_time = "frame" use image-index columns instead, keeps event timestamps row-aligned host aniframe (falls back seconds image-index columns present). FPS recorded sampling_rate metadata without rescaling timestamps. Closes #76.

title: aniread 0.5.0
text: File validation longer rejects readable files Windows network (UNC) shares. file.access() returns false negatives read permission paths; read check now falls back non-destructive open attempt file.access() reports access.

text: read_octron() now substantially faster large multi-segment files, especially properties requested.

title: aniread 0.4.1
text: read_octron(method = "weighted") longer silently recycles v * row’s value area columns different segment counts; falls back arithmetic mean rows emits single warning naming affected frame_idx values.

title: aniread 0.4.0
text: Readers whose source data uses image (top-left) origin now reflect y returned aniframe conventional bottom_left origin. fixes plots upside-without manual reorientation. Affects read_animalta(), read_bonsai(), read_deeplabcut(), read_fasttrack(), read_idtracker(), read_lightningpose(), read_movement(), read_octron(), read_sleap(), read_trackmate(), read_trex() (#61). aniframe (>= 0.5.0) now required, since reflection uses new set_origin() / set_y_height() API.

title: aniread 0.4.0
text: affected readers gain optional video_height argument supplying source frame height format record (DeepLabCut, LightningPose, SLEAP, AnimalTA, Bonsai, FastTrack, TRex, idtracker.ai CSV, movement netCDF). omitted, reader falls back source-extracted values available, finally max(y). read_idtracker() now reads /height trajectories h5 file default. read_trackmate() now reads frame height Settings/ImageData/@height XML default. read_octron() continues read video_height: CSV header, now also accepts video_height override stores value aniframe metadata. read_octron() gains method argument handle frames Octron emitted multiple mask segments track (#67). One "weighted" (default; area-weighted mean position shape props, sum areas), "largest" (single largest segment per row), "segments" (one row per segment, new segment identity variable).
